study_circumstances: please make rest days on tuesdays and thursdays

ai_study_plan.strategy: This week is designed to help you build a strong foundation by focusing on key skills in both Reading and Writing and Math. We’ll start with a balanced diagnostic week to identify your strengths and weaknesses, then gradually build up to targeted practice and review. Your lighter days will be rest days, so you can recharge and stay focused on the days that matter most.

days.task: Mastering Linear Equations in One Variable
days.rationale: Linear equations are a core skill for the Math section, and mastering them will help you tackle more complex problems with confidence.
days.completion_check: Complete 15 questions in 22.5 minutes with 100% accuracy.

blocks.title: Linear equations in one variable strategy review
blocks.description: Review the key rule, procedure, and common trap for Linear equations in one variable before beginning timed work.

blocks.title: Timed Math module
blocks.description: Complete one official-length Math module under test conditions. Flag uncertain questions instead of pausing.

blocks.title: Analyze misses and guesses
blocks.description: Review every incorrect or uncertain response. Record the tested skill, error pattern, and one prevention strategy.

days.rationale: Identifying central ideas is a key skill for the Reading and Writing section. This will help you quickly locate and understand the main points of passages.
days.completion_check: Complete 18 questions in 27 minutes with 100% accuracy.

blocks.title: Central Ideas and Details
blocks.description: Answer 18 questions about central ideas and details. Use 1.2 minutes per question. Focus on identifying the main idea and supporting details. Review any mistakes immediately.

blocks.title: Reviewing Central Idea Mistakes
blocks.description: Go over any mistakes from the drill and understand why they occurred. Reflect on how to avoid similar errors in the future.
